before.source:
version: 2
id: learn-from-repo
name: Learn from a repo
description: |
  Point it at a repository and a question. Orient says where this project
  stands in relation to it; the readings fan out in parallel; a synthesis
  merges them; the plan proposes claimable backlog work; the handoff queues it.
  Ported as-is from the v1 flow, with the fanout collapsed into parallel
  lanes over the same general-analysis block.
launchable: true

blocks:
  - id: orient
    use: flyt-blocks-inquiry:orient
    title: Where are we standing?
    config:
      effort: high
      instructions: |
        Say what THIS project is and what relationship it has to the repository:
        empty, the same kind of thing, overlapping problems, or no real overlap.
        A bounded survey — manifests and guidance plus at most two load-bearing
        files from each side. Everything after you is aimed by your answer.

  - id: read
    kind: parallel
    lanes:
      - id: read-architecture
        use: flyt-blocks-core:general-analysis
        title: Architecture
        config:
          instructions: |
            Read the repository and answer the question in the brief, on the
            architecture lane: how the thing is put together, and why. Ground
            every claim in a file and a line you actually opened.
      - id: read-practices
        use: flyt-blocks-core:general-analysis
        title: Practices
        config:
          instructions: |
            Read the repository and answer the question in the brief, on the
            practices lane: the conventions, tests and tooling it runs on.
            Ground every claim in a file and a line you actually opened.
      - id: read-adversarial
        use: flyt-blocks-core:general-analysis
        title: Adversarial
        config:
          instructions: |
            Read the repository and answer the question in the brief, on the
            adversarial lane: where it would fail, and what it quietly assumes.
            Ground every claim in a file and a line you actually opened.

  - id: synthesise
    use: flyt-blocks-core:general-analysis
    title: Merge the reads
    config:
      instructions: |
        Several independent readings of one repository follow, each with a
        different slant. Merge them into one account: what is agreed, what only
        one lane saw, and what they contradict. Where two lanes disagree, say so
        rather than picking a winner silently. Use the orientation to separate
        what is relevant here from what is not, and drop what does not apply.

  - id: plan
    use: flyt-blocks-loop:backlog-plan
    title: What we should do
    config:
      instructions: |
        Propose only work this project should genuinely do as a result of what
        was read. Confirm every path in blastRadius. Where a task points at the
        repository that was read, name the path as reference:<name>/<path> and
        say it lives there. If the orientation says the relation is unrelated, a
        short backlog or an honest "nothing here transfers" is the correct
        answer.

  - id: handoff
    use: flyt-blocks-loop:loop-handoff
    title: Queue it
